//: Yapfast is a Rust program; scripts/check is its gate (fmt, doc links, Clippy, tests, build, smoke). The Python, TypeScript and C under testing/ and scripts/, and the CI workflow, are the test and release tooling: they run on Linux under scripts/run-framework-isolated and the dev shell, not on the host that edits them. Their analyzers report the Linux-only calls they make (os.killpg, signal.SIGKILL, _IOFBF) as errors on Windows and apply ruff/eslint/yamllint defaults the project does not set.
